Staff confirms the subcommittee is ready to begin.

chapters.summary: Chair Christopher Marte opens the meeting, introduces colleagues Majority Whip Hanks, Councilmember Nurse, and Councilmember Thomas-Henry, and explains the hybrid format. He presents LU 114, an application by the Department of Parks and Recreation for acquisition and site selection of 31 privately owned sites for future parkland in Queens Community District 2, covering Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Blissville, and West Maspeth in Councilmembers Won and Krishnan's districts. Marte notes the local council members are supportive and calls for questions or remarks from subcommittee members.
chapters.title: Chair Marte introduces subcommittee and outlines LU 114 Queens CD2 Walk to Park acquisition

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Good morning.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Welcome to the meeting of the Subcommittee on Landmarks, Public Siting, Resiliency, and Disposition.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: I'm Councilmember Christopher-Marte and the chair of the subcommittee.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: I'm joined today by my colleagues, Councilmember Majority Whip Hanks, Councilmember Nurse, and Councilmember Thomas Henry.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Today's meeting is being held in hybrid format.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: On today's agenda, we have one vote for an application on the subcommittee heard last month.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Today we'll be voting on LU 114 for Queen CD2 walk to park acquisition and site selection, which is an application by the Department of Parks and Recreation for approval

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: of the city acquisition and site selection of 31 privately owned sites for future park development in Queens Community District 2.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: This proposal seeks to create new parkland and to increase access to open space resources for neighborhoods of Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Blissville, and West Maspeth, located in Councilmember Wan and Krishna districts.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Approval of this application will facilitate greater opportunities for DPR to potentially acquire private

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: property and develop a new public new parkland that would help close the walk to Park Gap in Queens CD2.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: The local council members are supportive of this application.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Members of the subcommittee who have questions or remarks today on this item, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: Seeing none, I call for a vote to approve LU 114.

chapters.summary: Chair Marte calls for a vote to approve LU 114. Council staff calls the roll: Marte votes aye, Hanks votes aye, Nurse votes aye, and Thomas-Henry votes aye. The item is adopted by a vote of four in the affirmative, zero in the negative, and zero abstentions, and referred to the full Land Use committee.

chapters.summary: Chair Marte thanks the public, his colleagues, subcommittee counsel, land use staff, and the sergeant at arms for their participation, and adjourns the meeting.
chapters.title: Chair Marte adjourns the subcommittee meeting

utterances.text: That concludes today's business.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte
utterances.text: I'd like to thank the members of the public, my colleagues, subcommittee counsel, land use staff, and the Sergeant at Arms for your participation today.

utterances.speaker: Christopher Marte

summary: The Subcommittee on Landmarks, Public Sitings, Resiliency and Dispositions held a brief hybrid meeting to vote on LU 114, the Queens CD2 Walk to Park site selection and acquisition application.

The application, submitted by the Department of Parks and Recreation and DCAS, seeks approval for acquisition and site selection of 31 privately owned sites for future park development across Long Island City, Sunnyside, Woodside, Blissville, and West Maspeth.
The subcommittee approved LU 114 by a unanimous 4-0 vote and referred it to the full Land Use committee.
